/* Insert combined catalog CSV with proper header and all deduplicated reagent rows */
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at)
WITH deduplicated AS (
  SELECT cas_number, name, quantity, location, lot_id, COALESCE(notes, '') as notes
  FROM reagents
  WHERE (cas_number, quantity) IN (
    SELECT cas_number, MAX(quantity)
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cas_number) as rn
  FROM deduplicated
)
SELECT 'lab_inventory' as recipient_org,
  'cas_number,name,quantity,location,lot_id,notes' || CHAR(10) ||
  GROUP_CONCAT(rn || ':' || csv_line, CHAR(10)) as payload,
  datetime('now') as created_at
FROM (
  SELECT cas_number, name, quantity, location, lot_id, notes,
         cas_number || ',' || name || ',' || quantity || ',' || location || ',' || lot_id || ',' || notes as csv_line
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn IN (1, 2, 3)
);
